basics.name: Manas Patel
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer / Platform Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Frontend Engineer with over 8 years of experience architecting high-scale single-page applications, UI platforms, micro-frontends, and distributed systems across global tech leaders including Atlassian, Apollo.io, Coinbase, Walmart Labs, and Cisco. Specialized in React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, and web performance optimization.
basics.aboutMe: Meet Manas Patel, a software engineer with a passion for building elegant and efficient web applications. Originally from Sundargarh, Manas calls Bangalore home. He attended Orissa Engineering College where he honed his skills and began his journey as a frontend developer, building systems across TCS, Cisco, Walmart, Coinbase, Apollo.io, and Atlassian.

work.name: Atlassian
work.summary: Engineering scalable UI platforms and distributed micro-frontend features.
highlights: Architecting robust UI components and resilient web systems across distributed cloud products.
Driving developer experience (DX), build system tooling, and testing best practices across feature pods.

work.name: Apollo.io
work.summary: Frontend platform engineering focused on build pipeline performance, Core Web Vitals, and test automation.
highlights: Optimized frontend build pipelines by configuring Webpack and SWC, slashing build times by 20% and deployment time by 30%.
Reduced bundle sizes by 25%, improving First Contentful Paint (FCP) and Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) by 10%.
Led version migration from React 16.x to 17.x, modernizing dependencies and improving developer ergonomics.
Engineered end-to-end frontend code coverage infrastructure from scratch using Cypress.
Deployed New Relic dashboards for real-time frontend static analysis, telemetry, and error tracking.

work.name: Coinbase
work.summary: Engineered workflow automation platforms, ML infrastructure interfaces, and graph data architectures.
highlights: Architected frontend for Bot Maker, a visual drag-and-drop workflow canvas saving ~$10M per year in operational costs.
Built internal tools enabling Machine Learning engineers to register, deploy, and inspect ML models, eliminating repeated manual tasks.
Spearheaded design and POC development of an AWS Neptune graph database to unify enterprise blockchain data indexing.

work.name: Walmart Labs India
work.summary: Full-stack frontend and API layer engineering for global retail platform Asda.com.
highlights: Designed and implemented Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) aggregator architecture using React.js, Node.js, and GraphQL, reducing configuration bugs by 50%.
Developed dynamic ad components for the ASDA.COM ad platform, driving ~20% incremental revenue growth from digital placements.
Managed global state caching using Redux and Redux-Reselect memoized selectors.
Expanded the in-house design system UI library to ensure mobile-first accessibility across checkout workflows.
Scaled unit testing coverage across services using Jest and Enzyme to minimize production defects.

work.name: Cisco Systems India Pvt. Ltd.
work.summary: Enterprise UI platform development for the Cisco DNA-C network management dashboard.
highlights: Engineered reusable UI plugins and micro-frontend modules for the DNA-C platform across distributed engineering teams.
Migrated legacy Backbone/jQuery code to modern React.js with Redux and Hooks.
Developed interactive device tree topology visualizers using React, HTML5 Canvas, and GoJS.
Boosted page load speeds by 30% utilizing route-based lazy loading, React.PureComponent memoization, and sprite optimizations.
Enforced TDD standards and SonarQube quality gates during peer reviews to reduce code smells.

work.name: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
work.summary: Enterprise UI development for Marks & Spencer Retail Product Planning (WSSI) platform.
highlights: Developed complex data-dense screens supporting multi-cell computations and spreadsheet-like operations.
Implemented predictable global client state management using Angular and NgRx.
Constructed reusable cross-team component libraries and design utilities following the Angular Style Guide.
Managed source control, CI/CD integration, and release branches using Git and GitHub.

certificates.name: Programming in HTML5 with JavaScript and CSS3
